title.value: Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading and Energy Conversion in Interconnected Multi-Energy Microgrids Using Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Peer-to-Peer Energy Trading and Energy Conversion in Interconnected Multi-Energy Microgrids Using Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning approach to address the external peer-to-peer (P2P) energy trading problem and internal energy conversion problem within interconnected residential, commercial, and industrial multi-energy microgrids (MEMGs). The approach aims to reduce costs and environmental impact by efficiently converting and storing energy.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on energy trading and conversion in microgrids, aiming to reduce costs and environmental impact, which aligns with sustainable development goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: A key aspect of multi-energy microgrids (MEMGs) is the capability to efficiently convert and store energy in order to reduce the costs and environmental impact

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing energy trading and conversion within microgrids to reduce environmental impact and costs, which falls under climate change mitigation.
primary_category.quote: A key aspect of multi-energy microgrids (MEMGs) is the capability to efficiently convert and store energy in order to reduce the costs and environmental impact

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper explores energy trading and conversion to optimize microgrid operations, which is directly related to renewable energy and grid optimization.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this paper, we investigate the external P2P energy trading problem and internal energy conversion problem within interconnected residential, commercial and industrial MEMGs. These two problems are complex decision-making problems with enormous high-dimensional data and uncertainty

applications.value: Grid optimization (scheduling)-grid becomes complex due to uptake of EV and renewables
applications.justification: The paper addresses the complexity of grid scheduling with the integration of renewables.
applications.quote: These two problems are complex decision-making problems with enormous high-dimensional data and uncertainty, so a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning approach combining the multi-agent actor-critic algorithm with the twin delayed deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm is proposed.
